text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The loud cheers echoing from the stands, 
and your shout, which was just as loud... 
are still ringing in my ears.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Even though they had such high hopes 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Next time... I want to answer those 
cheers. I want to gift them a victory...!"

Everyone's cheers give me strength. They 
make me want to keep running harder.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's always... been like that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We're both reliable to each other. Let's 
keep doing our best in training, okay?

text_block_list.text:
And next time, I'll definitely take 1st 
place. I'll win and show everyone my 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. How to conserve stamina, the timing 
of the final spurt... There's still plenty 
of room for growth.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I need to put in even more training.

is the word?

the view of victory... together!
